summary: Phase 60 Master Delivery Report: Universal Email Connector Framework. Delivers provider-independent connector architecture supporting Google Workspace, Microsoft 365, Yahoo, Zoho, iCloud, standards-based IMAP/SMTP, and custom gateways. Includes normalized ingestion models, universal sync engine with cursor recovery, Quad-Action outbound dispatch safeguards, anti-AI self-approval, air-gapped safeguarding isolation, 6-step wizard and dashboard UI, and a 35/35 passing verification suite with zero regressions across all prior test suites.
